Business focus: energy consumed without proportional output

Packaging cost limitation: the files contain packaging-handling minutes (Packmittel bereit / zurück) but no packaging material price/BOM. The dashboard therefore shows packaging-handling process cost exposure, not material cost per unit.
This page proves how the dashboard numbers are calculated from raw-source fields.

Reproducible count validation

The 430 / 398 / 263 numbers are set logic, not manually entered KPI values.

MES 2026 order population

MES Orders = DISTINCTCOUNT( normalized mes_production_periods_2026[OrderNo] )\nExclude blank/null keys\nResult = 430
The MES count intentionally uses production-period facts because the question is which orders actually appear in 2026 execution data, not which orders exist in the master table.

Operator Excel order population & intersection

Excel Orders = DISTINCTCOUNT( normalized excl_production_data_2026[Auftragskarte Nr.] ) = 398\nMatched = MES set ∩ Excel set = 263\nMES only = 430 - 263 = 167\nExcel only = 398 - 263 = 135\nUnion = 430 + 398 - 263 = 565
Normalization: convert to text, trim whitespace, remove numeric “.0” artefacts, exclude blank/null.
